ui_bugs.issue: Emergent 'Made with Emergent' badge (a[id=emergent-badge]) overlaps the WhatsApp FAB at the bottom-right and intercepts pointer events. Real users may need to tap precisely on the FAB circle. force=True/JS click works. This is a preview-env badge collision only — won't affect production where the badge is removed.

action_items: (Optional) Consider raising the z-index of [data-testid="whatsapp-fab"] above 50 or shifting it left of the Emergent badge so users in the preview environment can tap it without overlay collision. Not blocking — badge is preview-only.
After test sign-off, switch PAYMENT_MODE back to live (remove env override) so real Razorpay flow resumes. Currently /api/ returns payment_mode:mock.
critical_code_review_comments: Landing.jsx is ~340 lines and packs Nav + Hero + Pain + How + ReportTease + Features + SocialProof + Segments + Pricing + Trust + FAQ + Footer in one file. Approaching the 700-line guideline but readable; consider splitting per section file if it grows.

LeadGate intentionally swallows /api/lead failures (try/empty catch) to avoid blocking checkout — good for UX, but pre-payment leads will be silently dropped if backend is down. Consider a single retry or local-storage queue for resilience.
analytics.js GTM/GA4/Pixel IDs are blank by default; events still push to window.dataLayer (verified). No code change needed, just confirm IDs are set in prod env.
